propositions: AGENTS.md and docs/user-guide.md incorrectly state that the --force override for transition/claim operations is CLI-only and not exposed over MCP, contradicting the 2026-08-18 operator ruling and shipped code.

The ruling rescinded the CLI-only policy for --force; it is now allowed on all surfaces (library, CLI, MCP) with auditability enforced via absence of signed attestation rather than capability withholding.
The MCP docstrings in _mcp_writes.py were already updated to reflect the absent-attestation model on transition_ticket and claim_ticket; the canonical prose documentation has not caught up.

The stale CLI-only clauses in AGENTS.md (start-work-gate paragraph) and docs/user-guide.md (claim paragraph) must be rewritten to document force-everywhere + absent-attestation + CI-certification-enforcement model.
Out-of-scope CLI-only statements about other bypass families (--allow-secret-pattern, bridge setup wizard, release-notes wizard) must remain unchanged.
